Build and deploy new AI agent flows, intents, and configurations to support new products, BUs, campaigns, and seasonal initiatives. Experience with process design and automation (workflow tools, RPA, or CX platform administration). Experience running VOC programs (NPS/CSAT) and leading customer journey mapping. Strong analytical and reporting skills; comfortable working directly with dashboards and data tools. Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to partner effectively with Tech, Product, and peer CX Managers. Strong people leadership and coaching skills. Fluent in Arabic and English, written and verbal.

Apply Git-based team development practices, including code reviews and design reviews. Contribute to cloud-native development practices, with opportunities to work with Kubernetes and scalable deployment environments. Documentation & Team Collaboration Write clear technical documentation covering design decisions, software behavior, test results, and operational considerations. Collaborate with engineers, researchers, product stakeholders, and partner teams to deliver high-quality network software. Communicate technical findings clearly through logical problem analysis and structured reporting. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Experience: Experience developing commercial software. Implementation experience using the Go programming language. Basic knowledge of Linux and IP networking. Knowledge of virtualization technologies such as Docker. Knowledge of cloud computing and cloud-based development or testing environments. Team development experience using Git. Strong logical problem analysis, technical communication, and collaboration skills. TECHNICAL SKILLS Programming & Software Engineering Go, Rust, commercial software development, maintainable code design, unit testing, code reviews, and design reviews. Mobile Core & Telecom Protocols 3GPP specifications, EPC, IMS, 5GC, S1AP, PFCP, GTP, Diameter, RTP, SIP, and protocol-oriented software requirements. Cloud & Infrastructure Linux, IP networking, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, virtualization technologies, cloud computing, and cloud-native development environments. Testing & Fault Analysis Integration testing, interoperability testing, load testing, logs, packet captures, Wireshark, defect analysis, and quality improvement. Development Practices Git-based team development, technical documentation, structured problem solving, communication, and collaboration across engineering teams. Clear communication skills for technical documentation, design discussion, and team collaboration. Motivation to contribute to reliable Private Mobile Network products and next-generation wireless solutions.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview EWOK is Intuit’s enterprise regional failover and disaster recovery platform. It automates failover and recovery workflows across AWS regions so services stay available during regional outages. As a Tier-0 platform, EWOK must keep working when much of the rest of the ecosystem is down. It is evolving from a deterministic recovery tool into an AI-native platform. As a Senior Software Engineer on the EWOK team, you will design, scale, and operate the platform that underpins Intuit’s enterprise-wide resiliency posture. You will lead technical design across distributed orchestration, cross-region replication, and automated testing frameworks—directly driving down recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO) for hundreds of internal services. Responsibilities Utilizes extensive expertise in system engineering, software development, critical thinking, industry best practices, and AI to develop innovative solutions towards building highly available, scalable and reliable platforms. Expertly builds, operates, and scales services running on AWS infrastructure. Collaborates closely with Intuit Product and Platform Development Teams to plan, prioritize and design highly available cloud architectures. Participates in on-call and support rotations, driving incident recovery, resolution and Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Resolve defects/bugs during QA testing, pre-production, production, and post-release patches. Use critical thinking skills to debug issues as well as bring to light new problems and solutions to solve. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience delivering production-grade, distributed systems at scale. Distributed Systems & Cloud: Deep technical proficiency in AWS core architecture (e.g., IAM, Route 53, Step Functions, DynamoDB, VPC networking, cross-region data replication). Software Development: Strong production experience in Python and Go with a focus on concurrency, systems programming, and high-reliability backend services.
